title: macaranga harveyana
intro: Macaranga harveyana, commonly known as the "Pride of India" or "Mahua," is a deciduous tree native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Macaranga harveyana include antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for several diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
